title: SeismicPostStackTrace3DVolume
description: A single logical post stack dataset containing seismic samples related to a 3D volume.

id.description: Previously called ResourceID or SRN which identifies this OSDU resource object without version.
id.title: Entity ID

kind.description: The schema identification for the OSDU resource object following the pattern {Namespace}:{Source}:{Type}:{VersionMajor}.{VersionMinor}.{VersionPatch}. The versioning scheme follows the semantic versioning, https://semver.org/.
kind.title: Entity Kind

version.description: The version number of this OSDU resource; set by the framework.
version.title: Version Number

acl.description: The access control tags associated with this entity.
acl.title: Access Control List

legal.description: The entity's legal tags and compliance status. The actual contents associated with the legal tags is managed by the Compliance Service.
legal.title: Legal Tags

tags.title: Tag Dictionary
tags.description: A generic dictionary of string keys mapping to string value. Only strings are permitted as keys and values.

createTime.description: Timestamp of the time at which initial version of this OSDU resource object was created. Set by the System. The value is a combined date-time string in ISO-8601 given in UTC.
createTime.title: Resource Object Creation DateTime

createUser.title: Resource Object Creation User Reference
createUser.description: The user reference, which created the first version of this resource object. Set by the System.

modifyTime.description: Timestamp of the time at which this version of the OSDU resource object was created. Set by the System. The value is a combined date-time string in ISO-8601 given in UTC.
modifyTime.title: Resource Object Version Creation DateTime

modifyUser.title: Resource Object Version Creation User Reference
modifyUser.description: The user reference, which created this version of this resource object. Set by the System.

ancestry.description: The links to data, which constitute the inputs, from which this record instance is derived.
ancestry.title: Ancestry

meta.description: The Frame of Reference meta data section linking the named properties to self-contained definitions.
meta.title: Frame of Reference Meta Data

LiveTraceOutline.description: Polygon showing the coverage of live traces in the trace dataset

BinGridID.description: Reference to the WPC which describes the node positions of the processed bin centers.  These are indexed from the trace file using inline and crossline.

HorizontalCRSID.description: Coordinate reference system of positions in trace header, which matches what is described in BinGrid but is repeated here for convenience and in case bin grid is not defined.  In case of conflict with Bin Grid, this value applies to the coordinates as written into CMPX, CMPY headers. Nevertheless, Bin Grid should be used for mapping purposes.

Preferred3DInterpretationSetID.description: For a 3D volume (including linear subsets), the id of the Seismic3DInterpretationSet which can be considered the master for the area and of which this trace dataset is a privileged member.  It defines the set of trace datasets of a particular bin grid that form the best set for interpretation (not an acquisition survey).

SeismicDomainTypeID.description: ID of the nature of the vertical axis in the trace data set, usually Depth or Time.

SampleCount.description: Number of samples in the vertical direction.

StartVerticalIndex.description: The sample axis value in the vertical dimension at which the data starts. Use SeismicDomainType to know if data is in time or depth.

EndVerticalIndex.description: The sample axis value in the vertical dimension at which the data ends. Use SeismicDomainType to know if data is in time or depth.

TraceCount.description: How many traces are in the volume

TraceLength.description: Maximum trace length calculated using depth or time start and end points as appropriate according to SeismicDomainType.

TraceDomainUOM.description: UOM for vertical trace domain values

InlineIncrement.description: Sampling interval of inlines in this dataset (difference in labels between neighboring inlines).

CrosslineIncrement.description: Sampling interval of crosslines in this dataset (difference in labels between neighboring crosslines).

Precision.title: Precision
Precision.description: Sample data format in terms of sample value precision 8bit Integer, 16bit Floating Point etc.

WordFormat.description: SRN of a reference value for binary data types, such as INT, UINT, FLOAT, IBM_FLOAT, ASCII, EBCDIC.

WordWidth.description: Size of the word in bytes.

TextualFileHeader.description: Character metadata from headers inside file, such as the EBCDIC header of SEGY.  This is an array to capture each stanza separately.

RangeAmplitudeMax.description: The actual maximum amplitude value found in the dataset.

RangeAmplitudeMin.description: The actual minimum amplitude value found in the dataset.

SortOrderID.title: Sort Order ID
SortOrderID.description: Defines the sorting order of the trace data as stored in the file(s).

TimeLapseAssociations.title: Time Lapse Associations
TimeLapseAssociations.description: The contents positions the SeismicTraceData record in context of one or more time series. This is to be used for time lapse or 4D SeismicTraceData. This structure is optional and absent for SeismicTraceData not part of a time series.

SeismicPostStackProcessingProductID.description: The PostStack Processing Product that this volume is related to.

Contracts.description: References to applicable agreements in external contract database system of record.

AdditionalTraceHeaderRanges.title: Additional Trace Header Ranges
AdditionalTraceHeaderRanges.description: Minimum and maximum ranges parsed from trace headers for any additional parameters

items.title: Trace Header Range Summary
items.description: Minimum and maximum ranges parsed from trace headers for any additional parameters

Minimum.title: Minimum
Minimum.description: Minimum value parsed from trace headers

Maximum.title: Maximum
Maximum.description: Maximum value parsed from trace headers

KeyName.title: KeyName
KeyName.description: Relationship to a reference value for a name of a property header such as INLINE, CDPX.

VelocityModelID.title: Velocity Model ID
VelocityModelID.description: The velocity model used in the creation of this trace dataset
